Sherwood Anderson, Winesburg, Ohio.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/sherwood-anderson/winesburg-ohio

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Sherwood Anderson, the author, died 1941 (Wikidata Q233898; death 1941-03-08 in the facts file).
- Irving Howe, the writer of the introduction, died 1993 (Wikidata Q728615; death 1993-05-05 in the facts file).

First publication of the text used: 1919 (SE colophon: 'Winesburg, Ohio was published in 1919 by Sherwood Anderson'; first edition 8 May 1919, publisher B. W. Huebsch, publication place United States, per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winesburg,_Ohio)

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1919, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published in the United States in 1919 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winesburg,_Ohio). A text first published in the United States before 1931 takes the United States rule for its origin, whatever the death years of the people whose words are in it, so the death of Irving Howe in 1993 does not change this decision.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
